scope.state_space: The six-dimensional cross-polytope diamond_6 = {v in R^6 : ||v||_1 <= 1}.
scope.effect_model: Full affine effect model used by Bencze--Frenkel.
scope.simulation: Exact input-output simulation of every measurement transition matrix with free shared randomness.
scope.classical_alphabet: Three states means a trit, not three bits and not a three-dimensional simplex.

limits: No proof-assistant formalization.
No human peer review.
Does not determine sign.dim(diamond_7), which remains between four and five.

claims.statement: For positive integers d, sign.dim(diamond_d) = 3 if and only if 3 <= d <= 6.
evidence: prior exact values in dimensions three through five
the prior logarithmic lower bound for dimensions at least seven
limits: The only new mathematical information in this corollary is the dimension-six case.

claims.statement: The shipped representative lists cover every basepoint-normalized six- and seven-point support: 14,303 and 118,827 coordinate-permutation classes, whose orbit sizes cover 6,054,006 and 63,602,770 labelled supports.
claims.locator: paper.tex, binary-matrix reduction and enumeration table
limits: These counts are rooted or basepoint-normalized records, not full cube-symmetry classes.
The generator proposes the lists; the orbit-size proof establishes coverage independently of generator completeness.

claims.statement: Exact rational filtering retains 39 six-point and 178 seven-point valid primitive-measurement records; all 217 admit exact three-state certificates, with 87 using the small-facet construction and 130 using saved general rational distributions.
limits: Zero valid measurement classes are infeasible; rejected candidate supports are not called infeasible measurement classes.
Producer floating-point screening is not trusted for the accepted classification.
A single saved subset distribution must work across all twelve extremal input states of each measurement.

claims.statement: Within the verified 217-record corpus, full signed-coordinate symmetry merges the records into 49 classes, and the 130 difficult records into 28 classes.
claims.locator: paper.tex, discussion of rooted versus full symmetry
limits: The catalogue organizes the already verified corpus and does not independently prove ambient completeness.
Counts split as 12 plus 37 full classes and 5 plus 23 difficult full classes.

claims.statement: Every subset receiving positive simulator mass must meet every coordinate-facet intersection of the measurement support.
limits: This restriction is not claimed as historically new.
It is insufficient for feasibility and does not construct the required common distribution.
No speedup benchmark or uniform construction for the 28 difficult classes is claimed.

claims.statement: No inspected source proved the exact dimension-six value before this work.
limits: Not a universal priority guarantee.
Does not exclude private, deleted, inaccessible, unindexed, contemporaneous, or differently phrased work.
An external minimal-balanced catalogue was not obtained or compared.

assessment.uncertainty: Credible 2-star/3-star overall boundary; no present 4-star basis.
limits: Not an official REF assessment.
